####################################################################################################
Purpose of script: This script demonstrates running a single Bayesian regression model using the 
'brms' package. It is designed as a playground to verify that a model can be executed successfully.
####################################################################################################

# Load packages and directories
```{r}
rm(list = ls())
source("../00_pck.R")

# Define pathogen
args_pat <- "rota"
# Define doses
dose <- case_when(
  args_pat %in% c("vzv", "measl", "mumps", "rubel", "hav", "multi_mmr-vzv", "multi_mmr") ~ "v1",
  args_pat == "rota" ~ "vl",
  .default = "v3")
```

# Read in the data ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
```{r}
args_dat <- glue("data_brms_{args_pat}_{dose}_s08.rds")
dat <- readRDS(file = glue("{dirs$modfit}/{args_dat}"))
```

# Retrieve your model formula from the command line arguments (in server script ) ------------------
```{r}
l_formula <- readRDS(file = glue("{dirs$modfit}/formula_brms_{args_pat}_l.rds"))
args_fo <- names(l_formula)[[3]]
args_fo
```

# Retrieve the iters from the command line arguments (in server script ) ---------------------------
```{r}
args_iter <- 2000
# Add criterion? 
crit <- FALSE
```

# Run the models -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
```{r}
mod <- brm(formula = l_formula[[args_fo]],
             data = dat, family = Gamma(link = "log"),
             warmup = 1000, iter = args_iter, chains = 1,
             init = 0, control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95), save_pars = save_pars(all = TRUE))

if(crit == TRUE) mod <- add_criterion(mod, criterion = c("waic"))
```

# Check it -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
```{r}
plot(mod)
conditional_effects(mod)
mod
stancode(mod)
```

####################################################################################################
END
